searchText: Not sure why this isn't auto merging. Is there something i'm missing? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3563 Hmm, multiple problems. You are changing the status, which cannot be auto-merged. The new bot didn't go red like it should have (cc <@104006934562107392>) and the old bot didn't run at all. <@!301186049323958275> what are the allowed statuses to be changed to? if any User can only freely merge to Withdrawn. (I think that is what it is called) Everything else requires an editor review. I guess Last Call => Review would be OK to auto-merge as well. okay, i'll add that Should it be okay to go from DRAFT -> REVIEW without editor approval? If it makes it to Draft then it should be formated and such correctly already So that an EIP is ready and requested to be reviewed seems it could be Author discretion as well. Well shit. Can I get a Merge then? cc <@!543900561460822016> No. We are much more strict about each stage. Draft basically just requires you have the form filled out correctly. Draft -> Review requires you follow a bunch of other rules. Ahhh, okay. Thats fine then Review -> Last Call requires that your EIP is flawless quality. Got it Should I revert to DRAFT and let it automerge first then? Also, sometimes people will take a well formatted draft and ruin it while iterating on it before review. That I believe You don't have to. Only reason I haven't merged was to give Alita a chance to look to see why the bot didn't block it like it should. Also, I'm *super* busy and have 60+ emails to go through. 😖 okay, np. We can let Alita take a look and i'll ping Lightclient later 🙂 When I get back later today i'm going to do some back testing on the simulation, and some charts to sanity check.
